Callout.Name: Multiple Casualties - Stabbing
Callout.Advisory: Both conscious, suspect gone, blood on the pavement.

Script.Line: It was three of them and it was quick.
My friend is by the bins. He is worse off than me.
I cannot stand up. Every time I try, it goes.

Callout.Patient: He got me in the side. I cannot stand up.

Lines.Approach: Two of them and one is much worse than the other. Start with the quiet one.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
